questions.question: What is a circuit diagram, and give two reasons why symbols are used.
questions.expected_answer: A circuit diagram is a drawing that uses symbols to show the components of a circuit and how they are connected. Symbols are used because they are quick and easy to draw, clear, leaving out unimportant details, and the same all over the world, so anyone can read them.

questions.question: Describe the symbols for a cell, a battery, a bulb, an open switch, a closed switch and a motor.
questions.expected_answer: A cell is a long thin line and a short thick line side by side; the long line is positive. A battery is two or more cell symbols joined in a row. A bulb is a circle with a cross inside. An open switch is a gap with a short line tilted up like an open gate. A closed switch has that line lying flat across the gap. A motor is a circle with a capital M inside.

questions.question: Give three rules for drawing a good circuit diagram.
questions.expected_answer: Use a ruler and a sharp pencil. Draw wires as straight lines with square corners, usually in a rectangle. Leave no gaps in the lines except at an open switch. Draw each symbol in the position of that component in the loop.
